posts.raw_content:
Everyone is really worked up about stupid shit. Some dumb bitch named Karen Hao who also happens to be Chinese wrote a book called Empire of AI. In that book she claimed that one google data center in Chile would use 1000x more water than the local population each year. She later corrected herself as her data was off by a magnitude of 1000x so in reality the data center uses less water than some third world shithole in Chile.

But the damage was done. And now the blithering idiots are foaming at the mouths. Turns out we already have 5400 "data centers" in America. But they fucking suck. They are old server farms built to house servers for AOL dial up tier shit. Sure we can renovate them a little bit but why. Every day more retards spend their time using the internet for really important stuff like tik tok or dog memes. And the old system is pretty worn out and obsolete. 

That is the reason Trump wants more new data centers. There is a push from David Sacks and the Data Center Coalition to build more and fast. But that doesn't mean it needs to be a bad thing especially since now we are also mandating they have their own power.

I would love to live the ideal life of a luddite , but the reality is that the rest of the world especially assholes like China are expanding their data centers too and it has become an arms race. Trump wants America to be the best he can make it so obviously he wants us to have the biggest and best data centers.

I think we should embrace it but force them to be built in Democrat run urban cities like Baltimore and Detroit and Chicago and LA. Give the people what they want. More world star and tik tok bandwith.

We are running into a scalability wall. You can only upgrade the old shit so much before its just a fucking doorstop that plays number munchers and oregon trail. We are at that point. Same reason we need more fiber everywhere too.

It isn't really a big deal but a clever campaign by China and paid influencers has made this non issue into a really big issue now and people are being mislead about it.

Hope this at least helps a few people get some perspective even if they want to disagree it is important we understand that building new data centers is like upgrading from payphones to Cellphones or going from 2g  to 5g for cell towers it isn't installing some new foreign menacing electronic ecosystem into our lives that isn't already there.
